conclusions.febrianto: Zero-mean discrepancy prior d ~ N(0, C_d); squared-exponential kernel in SPACE ONLY; quasi-static strain; gamma_k scales the discrepancy VARIANCE with load magnitude, it is not a mean function. Non-sensor predictive mean moves through the conditioned FE state. A non-zero frequency x location discrepancy MEAN is NOT in this paper.
conclusions.schneider: Zero-mean Gaussian in log-magnitude and phase (Eq. 18); additive frequency + accelerometer-location CORRELATION (Eqs. 19-21) with posterior l_co,z ~ 49.8 m, l_co,f ~ 10.1 Hz, r = 0.82. Transformed-space zero mean, NOT a structured mean. Nuance: the multiplicative amplitude error is lognormal, so its arithmetic mean in the original amplitude space need not be 1.
conclusions.allowed_claim: The requested learned frequency x location MEAN is absent from these two papers.
conclusions.forbidden_claim: No literature-wide novelty gap is claimed; that needs a systematic review this run did not perform.
